# Third-party wallpapers: credits, sources and licence status

**These images are other people's artwork.** They are not covered by surfd's MIT / CC BY-SA 4.0
licences (see `LICENSES/LicenseRef-third-party-unverified.txt`). The maintainer has chosen to ship
them in the `surfd-wallpapers` package and the live ISO. Their licences have **not** been confirmed,
and the source terms below may not allow redistribution. **If you made one of these and want it
credited differently or removed, open an issue at https://github.com/advay-saha/surfd/issues and
it will be taken out.**

Sources are as given by the maintainer; artist names come from file names or signatures and are
not verified.

## `dynamic/`: time-of-day sets (source: Dynamic Wallpaper Club, dynamicwallpaper.club)

Converted from Apple dynamic HEIC files with `tools/wallpapers/heic2surfd.py`. Dynamic Wallpaper
Club's terms allow personal, non-commercial use and ask that both the author and Dynamic Wallpaper
Club are credited; they list redistribution as a prohibited use.

| `japanese-garden` | ArseniXC |
